howItWorksPage.title: How it works
howItWorksPage.subtitle: A detailed guide to every feature in Sporly.ai — from connecting your platforms to reading your analytics.

connect.title: Connect your platforms
connect.subtitle: Connecting your social accounts is the first step. It unlocks real analytics and makes your strategy much more accurate.

step1.title: Go to Settings
step1.desc: Click on your account name in the top-right corner and select Settings. You'll find the integrations section there.

step2.title: Choose a platform
step2.desc: Select Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube and click Connect. You'll be redirected to the platform's authorization page.

step3.title: Authorize access
step3.desc: Log in with your account and grant the required permissions. Sporly.ai only reads your public content and analytics — it never posts on your behalf.

step4.title: Sync your data
step4.desc: After connecting, click Sync Now to pull in your latest posts and metrics. You can sync again at any time to refresh the data.

connect.tip: You can connect all three platforms at once. The Dashboard lets you switch between them to compare performance.

strategy.title: Generate your strategy
strategy.subtitle: Your strategy is built by AI using the profile you filled in during onboarding. The more detailed your profile, the more tailored the output.

step1.title: Open the Strategy tab
step1.desc: Click on Strategy in the navigation bar. If you haven't generated one yet, the page will be empty with a Generate button.

step2.title: Choose a period
step2.desc: Select 1, 3, or 6 months as a preset, or pick a custom date range. The period defines how far ahead your strategy will plan.

step3.title: Handle overlaps
step3.desc: If you already have a strategy for a period that overlaps, Sporly.ai will warn you and ask if you want to overwrite it. You can always keep the existing one.

step4.title: Read your strategy
step4.desc: Your strategy includes a summary, positioning statement, core objectives, content pillars with formats, platform-specific direction, growth moves, and a 30-day focus plan.

step5.title: Regenerate when needed
step5.desc: Goals change. Regenerate your strategy at any time — for a new period or to refresh your direction. Each generation uses your latest onboarding data.

strategy.tip: For the best results, make sure your onboarding profile is detailed and up to date. Strategy quality is directly tied to the quality of your profile.

calendar.title: Plan content in the Calendar
calendar.subtitle: The Calendar is your execution layer. This is where your strategy becomes real posts, scheduled on actual dates.

step1.title: Switch views
step1.desc: Use the Month and Week toggle at the top to switch between views. Month view gives you a bird's-eye overview; Week view shows more detail.

step2.title: Add a post manually
step2.desc: Click on any day in the calendar or use the Add button. Fill in the title, platform, status (idea, scheduled, posted), content pillar, and date.

step3.title: Generate content with AI
step3.desc: Click Generate with AI to automatically create a set of content ideas based on your strategy. Choose the period, confirm any overlaps, and the calendar fills up with planned posts.

step4.title: Manage your ideas
step4.desc: Use the Ideas section below the calendar to store unscheduled post concepts. Search and filter by platform to find what you need quickly.

step5.title: Update post status
step5.desc: Click any item to edit it. Update the status to Posted once you publish — this keeps your calendar accurate and helps track execution.

calendar.tip: Generate your strategy first, then use Generate with AI in the Calendar. The AI will read your strategy to create content that fits your pillars and platform approach.

dashboard.title: Track performance on the Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: The Dashboard gives you a real-time view of how your content is performing — for any connected platform.

step1.title: Select a platform
step1.desc: Use the dropdown at the top right to switch between Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. Each platform shows its own metrics.

step2.title: Read your analytics
step2.desc: The Analytics Cards show total views, average views per post, engagement rate, and total likes or comments — based on your last 25 posts.

step3.title: See your top content
step3.desc: The Top Performing Content widget shows your 4 best posts with views, likes, and comments. Click any post to open it directly on the platform.

step4.title: Check upcoming posts
step4.desc: The Upcoming Schedule widget pulls the next few scheduled items from your Calendar so you always know what's coming up next.

step5.title: Sync to refresh
step5.desc: Data doesn't update in real time. Click Sync Now on the platform connection card to pull in the latest posts and metrics from that platform.

dashboard.tip: Connect at least one platform before visiting the Dashboard. Without a connected account, the analytics cards and top content widget will be empty.

tutorial.title: Welcome to Sporly.ai 👋
tutorial.subtitle: Here's a quick overview of everything you can do.

step0.title: Welcome to Sporly.ai!
step0.desc:
Sporly.ai is your all-in-one content strategy platform. It helps you plan, create, and track content across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube — powered by AI that understands your goals and audience.

This short guide will walk you through the 4 main things you can do. It only takes a minute.

step1.title: Connect your platforms
step1.desc:
Start by heading to Settings and connecting your social accounts. Sporly.ai supports Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.

Once connected, Sporly.ai can pull your real analytics — views, likes, comments, and your top-performing content — directly into your Dashboard. You can connect multiple platforms and switch between them at any time.

step2.title: Generate your content strategy
step2.desc:
Go to the Strategy tab and click Generate. You choose a period — 1, 3, or 6 months, or a custom date range — and the AI builds a full content strategy based on your onboarding profile.

Your strategy includes content pillars, recommended formats, a platform-specific approach, growth moves, and a 30-day focus plan. You can regenerate it whenever your goals change.

step3.title: Plan your content in the Calendar
step3.desc:
The Calendar is where your ideas become a schedule. You can manually add posts, set a platform, status, and date — or use the Generate AI button to automatically populate your calendar with content ideas pulled from your strategy.

Switch between month and week view, filter by platform, and search across all your ideas. Everything stays organized in one place.

step4.title: Track your performance
step4.desc:
Once your platforms are connected, your Dashboard becomes your analytics hub. Select a platform from the top-right dropdown to see key metrics: views, likes, comments, and engagement.

The Top Content widget shows your best-performing posts, and the Upcoming Calendar widget gives you a quick look at what's scheduled next. Everything updates automatically when you sync your accounts.

featuresPage.heroSubtitle: Sporly.ai is a strategy and content system for creators and businesses. Here's a detailed look at each feature and what it actually does.
featuresPage.ctaTitle: Build your strategy and start planning content today
featuresPage.ctaSubtitle: It takes a few minutes to complete onboarding and generate your first strategy. No credit card required.

strategy.label: AI Strategy
strategy.title: A full content strategy built around your profile
strategy.subtitle: Sporly.ai doesn't give you a generic strategy. It generates one based on your specific goals, audience, challenges, platforms, and content style — all collected during onboarding.
strategy.b1: Positioning statement — how to present yourself clearly online
strategy.b2: Core objectives — 3–5 specific goals aligned to your period
strategy.b3: Content pillars — recurring themes with recommended formats per pillar
strategy.b4: Platform strategy — a specific direction for each platform you use
strategy.b5: Growth moves — concrete actions to expand your reach
strategy.b6: 30-day focus plan — an immediate action list to get started
strategy.note: You can generate strategies for 1, 3, or 6 months, or a custom date range. Regenerate whenever your goals evolve.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.title: Real platform data in one place
analytics.subtitle: Connect Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube to pull your actual performance data into Sporly.ai. No more switching between platform apps to understand what's working.
analytics.b1: Total and average views per post
analytics.b2: Engagement rate and total engagement across posts
analytics.b4: Top 4 best-performing posts with direct links to each
analytics.b5: Per-platform breakdown — switch between accounts in one click
analytics.b6: Manual sync — refresh data whenever you need the latest numbers
analytics.note: Analytics are based on your last 25 posts per platform. The more you sync, the more accurate your dashboard stays.

calendar.label: Content Calendar
calendar.title: Plan and schedule your content, manually or with AI
calendar.subtitle: The Calendar is where strategy becomes execution. You can plan posts by hand or let AI generate a full set of content ideas directly from your strategy.
calendar.b1: Month and week views — choose the layout that fits your workflow
calendar.b2: Add posts manually — set title, platform, date, status, and content pillar
calendar.b3: AI-generated content — populate the calendar from your active strategy in one click
calendar.b4: Ideas bank — store unscheduled concepts until you're ready to plan them
calendar.b5: Search and filter — find any idea instantly by keyword or platform
calendar.b6: Status tracking — mark posts as Idea, Scheduled, or Posted to stay on track
calendar.note: AI-generated calendar content pulls directly from your strategy pillars and platform direction — not random topics.

onboarding.label: Onboarding
onboarding.title: Built for creators and businesses — two separate profiles
onboarding.subtitle: Sporly.ai adapts to your profile type. Whether you're a content creator growing an audience or a business owner generating leads, the onboarding collects exactly what each profile needs.
onboarding.b1: Creator profile — goals, challenges, audience, content style, voice, platforms, and posting habits
onboarding.b2: Business profile — industry, products, social goals, KPIs, ideal customer, and budget
onboarding.b3: Structured audience builder — age range, gender, location, interests, and pain points
onboarding.b4: Content style selector — pick from 10 communication styles that describe how you show up
onboarding.b5: Theme library — 15 recurring topics to anchor your content direction
onboarding.b6: Platform setup — choose your platforms and set a primary one for focused strategy
onboarding.note: Your onboarding data is used every time you generate a strategy or calendar content. A detailed profile means a better result.

integrations.label: Integrations
integrations.title: Connect Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube
integrations.subtitle: Sporly.ai connects to your social platforms via official APIs. Authorization is secure, read-only, and takes less than a minute per platform.
integrations.b1: Instagram — connect your business or creator account via Meta
integrations.b2: TikTok — authorize access to your TikTok content and stats
integrations.b3: YouTube — connect your channel via Google OAuth
integrations.b4: Read-only access — Sporly.ai never posts, edits, or deletes content on your behalf
integrations.b5: Multi-platform — all three can be connected simultaneously
integrations.b6: Manual sync — you decide when to refresh your data
integrations.note: You can use Sporly.ai without connecting any platforms — strategy and calendar work independently. But analytics and top content require at least one connection.
